description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary: Master of House Mercere, an un-Gifted Redcap, senior Redcap of the Rhine Tribunal and master of Fengheld's Mercer House, where many Redcaps rest between journeys. A famous and prolific author of high-quality books on a huge range of mundane subjects and on Magic Theory, the backbone of most Rhine apprenticeships; corpulent, with a near-encyclopaedic memory consulted at Tribunal on obscure points of Hermetic law. Wholly apolitical, so his knowledge of the Order's business is of no political use to Fengheld. He wrote the visitor's account of Durenmar.

characters.name: Eule

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary: Master of House Bjornaer with the honorary rank of Quaesitor from House Guernicus, retired from official duty; for many years she was the Rhine's only senior Quaesitor. Owl heartbeast, and with Caecilius of Durenmar and Schadrit of Dankmar one of the oldest magi in the Tribunal. Magi still come to her for her celebrated advice.

secrets.title: Eule in Final Twilight
secrets.text: Only her filius Günther Lupus suspects that she has passed into Final Twilight: she has not taken human shape for years and has not spoken for longer.

secrets.title: Eule's wisdom
secrets.text: Her wisdom is a fraud. An item hidden in the floor of her audience room casts an effect that calms the mind and strips emotion, Günther translates her hoots with a few leading prompts, and the calmed petitioners find their own answers and thank Eule.

secrets.title: Storyguide Notes
secrets.text: The item in her audience room casts a low-level, very high Penetration Perdo Mentem effect.

characters.name: Peter von Würzburg

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary: Master of House Verditius, a celebrated vintner and grape-grower within the Order and among the nobles of southern Saxony and Thuringia. Minor enchanted items let the vines on Fengheld's south slope thrive this far north, and he turns special varieties into wines that are Charged Items; his squirrel familiar is as industrious as he is, and the two are seen tying vines, testing the sweetness and fertilising. Usually the first magus a visitor meets, out among the grapes; he oversees the head vintner, the orchard keeper and the farm foreman.

characters.name: Dorana

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary: Master of House Bonisagus, the leading maga in the Rhine of the lineage of Irmele filia Trianoma. Decades as a peregrinator before she settled at Fengheld taught her nearly every covenant and many magi of the Tribunal in detail; she argues for reason and peace in Fengheld's dealings and usually wins. She detests her Prima, Murion, pressing Stentorius to contest the Oak Gild and her close ally Occultes of Durenmar to contest the Primacy. A weather specialist, she manages the sun, rain and visitor-deterring fog that Fengheld's farms and privacy depend on; her latest apprentice Felicia has just passed her Gauntlet and gone travelling.

characters.name: Indulius

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely. The book gives no age: 65 is assumed from the magus's rank.

characters.summary: Master of House Flambeau and a feared hoplite, who hunts oath-breakers in an odd but effective pairing with Günther Lupus.

characters.name: Günther Lupus

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely. The book gives no age: 55 is assumed from the magus's rank.

characters.summary: Magus of House Bjornaer (rank not given), Eule's filius, wolf heartbeast. He hunts oath-breakers with Indulius and attends his ancient parens.

secrets.title: The Eule fraud
secrets.text: He is the author of the Eule fraud, keeping up the myth of her wisdom with a hidden Perdo Mentem item and his own translation of her hoots.

characters.name: Balastor

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary: Journeyman of House Criamon whose philosophy matches the Hawthorn Gild. Born feral, he had a powerful vital spirit his master saw fade as he learned speech and human ways, and he now means to return himself, and others whether they consent or not, to that primal state, holding that enlightenment demands casting off the mundane. His magic releases suppressed emotion and behaviour, and a Warped Magic flaw gives his face a savage cast when he casts; a puckish troublemaker who loves humbling self-important mundanes.

characters.name: Beechleaf

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary: Journeyman of House Merinita, fresh-faced, apprenticed at Irencillia by the Primus Handri and newly offered a place at Fengheld's main site, which makes him uneasy because he cannot see the political reason for it. Raised by a dryad, he understands faeries far better than people; his skin is faintly green and his bronze hair stirs in a wind nobody else feels.

characters.name: Rudolph

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely. The book gives no age: 45 is assumed from the magus's rank.

characters.summary: Magus of House Bonisagus (rank not given) and author of the plan to plant a Fengheld chapter inside Durenmar itself, which Fengheld backs cautiously and some of its seniors doubt. His membership of Fengheld is implied rather than stated.

characters.name: Clemens

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely. The book gives no age: 65 is assumed from the magus's rank.

characters.summary: Master of House Tremere, filius of Stentorius and Fengheld's most senior master, who runs its biggest chapter house. Where that chapter lies is left to the storyguide, perhaps near the player covenant; nothing else is given of him.

characters.name: Marguerite

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely. The book gives no age: 40 is assumed from the magus's rank.

characters.summary: Maga of House Flambeau (rank not given) who lives at Fengheld House, the covenant's most remote chapter: a simple fortified townhouse in Cherbourg in Normandy, outside the Rhine, owned by Sir Jozef of Poznan, a Polish-born crusader, and running a small trade with England and France. Stunningly beautiful and every bit as rude, she holds mundanes beneath her and never passes up a cutting remark.

characters.name: Wilhelm Weiss

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely. The book gives no age: 60 is assumed from the magus's rank.

characters.summary: Master of House Jerbiton and co-leader of the Apple Gild, who lives at the Rheingasse chapter in the centre of Cologne, where he and Garrinchus, both Gentle-Gifted, arrange Fengheld's supplies and mundane contacts very ably. He poses as a wealthy merchant.

characters.name: Garrinchus

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely. The book gives no age: 27 is assumed from the magus's rank.

characters.summary: Newly Gauntleted journeyman of House Ex Miscellanea and of the Apple Gild, living at the Rheingasse chapter in Cologne with Wilhelm Weiss, where the two Gentle-Gifted magi see to Fengheld's supplies and contacts. His master was a recognised expert in physick.

characters.name: Hassan El-Megrayhi

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely. The book gives no age: 80 is assumed from the magus's rank.

characters.summary: Master of House Criamon and astronomer, who lives at Turris Acontiarum, a solitary tower in the Kyffhäuser Mountains on the Saxon-Thuringian border, studying the stars with a single mute companion. He is parens of Hachim al'Khalejj of Waddenzee.

characters.name: Odorpes

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely. The book gives no age: 60 is assumed from the magus's rank.

characters.summary: Maga of House Bjornaer (rank not given), filia of Urgen, Archmage of Crintera, and sole inhabitant of the Lusatia chapter, an idyllic house on a bend of the Spree in the March of Lusatia only ten miles from the agreed Novgorod border, whose founding caused the latest boundary dispute between the two Tribunals. Bear heartbeast, in which she spends most of her time, hibernating all winter; a poor member, accused by Fengheld at Tribunal more than once of neglecting her duties, but never punished hard for fear of her aggressive, powerful parens.

secrets.title: Odorpes's lineage
secrets.text: She and Urgen are the two living magi of a hidden lineage of bear-heartbeast Bjornaer descending from the Founder herself.

secrets.title: The Bears' Cave
secrets.text: Odorpes and Urgen harvest the Bears' Cave in the northern Harz.

characters.name: Signum Irruptus

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Master of House Criamon and leader of Heorot, whose magi serve the Ash Gild's chief interest.

He is consumed by the trolls of Zealand, which he holds to be the degenerate descendants of old gods, and his study of them has cost the covenant fourteen grogs and him his left arm. He carries on regardless.

characters.name: Theoderich of Augsburg

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Journeyman of House Jerbiton, formerly of Oculus Septentrionalis, and Heorot's historian.

A necromancer by method, he raises the ghosts of the dead and questions them about the past. It frustrates him that he has not yet found the remains of Hrothgar or of Beowulf, on whose ground the covenant is said to stand.

characters.name: Pancrestis filius Occultes

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Journeyman of House Bonisagus at Heorot, who means to meet a Norse wizard and learn that magic for the Order.

His parens Occultes is famous and his mentor, the Archmage Philippus Niger of Durenmar, has impressed on him how urgently the Order needs those secrets revealed. Yet a deep dread of the wilderness has so far kept him from setting foot in pagan Scandinavia.

characters.name: Urgen

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Archmagus of House Bjornaer, Senior Elder in the Seat of the Bear, leader of the Hawthorn Gild and Primus of the House from 1165 to 1203, through the Danish invasion. His heartbeast is a bear.

He is the most influential of the Wilderists, holding that the Order must check the swelling mundane population and that Bjornaer must enter Hermetic politics to do so. Twice in fifty years he has torn a powerful magus apart in Wizard War, and his age and his victories earn him respect; support for him grows the longer the occupation of Rügen lasts.

characters.name: Falke

description.biography: Prima of House Bjornaer, Famous since she took the post; her heartbeast is a silver-grey falcon. Equipment: her talisman, a silver anklet set with crystal and amber (attuned +5 to water effects, +3 Corpus), which turns into a leg-band when she changes shape and can read a person's motives; Encumbrance 0 (0). Twilight Scar: her feet are always wet and leave puddles.

characters.summary:
Master of House Bjornaer, Linden Gild trained, and its Prima in the Seat of the Wolf since 1203. Her heartbeast is a silver-grey falcon with white-banded wings; she looks about 45 and passed her Gauntlet at 23.

Raised at Fengheld, she rose to prominence with an impassioned plea at the Tribunal of 1194 to let Crintera resist the Danes. She leans Harmonist without declaring it and governs by patience and seclusion, working to win back the trust of the Quaesitors and the Order. She has just become a Master and taken her first apprentice, and each spring casts the ritual at Arkona that thaws the Baltic.

Her magic centres on bodies of water, Aquam above all, and a Twilight scar keeps her feet always wet, leaving a puddle wherever she stands still. She is small and lithe, plain but commanding, with silky uniform grey hair, simply dressed and always barefoot to show her talisman, a silver anklet patterned in watery crystal and amber. Not suited to play as a player character.

characters.name: Jon Arnsson

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Master of House Bjornaer and protector of Crintera in the Seat of the Stag since the Gathering of 1167, a year before the invasion. His heartbeast is a lion.

A devout Christian who regards Valdemar's Church-backed conquest as righteous, yet fiercely loyal to Crintera, he is a man of divided and conflicted loyalties whose theology any other Christian would call heresy. Gentle and hating violence, he accepts its necessity and, as protector, joins Wizard's Marches against Bjornaer when he can. The second eldest after Urgen, he is a fervent Harmonist.

characters.name: Phyllia

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Master of House Bjornaer in the Seat of the Eagle, who keeps the council informed about the Order. Her heartbeast is a polecat.

She travels widely and has contacts across the Tribunal and beyond, but is a notorious gossip, quite unable to keep a secret. A Harmonist.

characters.name: Ardea

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Master of House Bjornaer and leader of its rituals in the Seat of the Swan. Her heartbeast is a heron.

Quiet and contemplative, a famous seer and diviner with a hunger for magical knowledge worthy of a Bonisagus, she keeps her political opinions to herself because her word carries such weight, and sides with neither faction. She stages the re-enactments of old legends at the Gathering.

characters.name: Istvan Padas

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Master of House Bjornaer in the Seat of the Horse, which keeps track of Crintera's magi and of every Bjornaer. His heartbeast is a magnificent stallion.

The youngest and most wilful Elder, a man of action, he descends from a line of horse-shaped Bjornaer taken into the House from the invading Magyars in the Order's early days. A Wilderist, strongly backed by his lover Zora, priestess of Hertha. His predecessor in the Seat died trying to climb the Königstuhl.

characters.name: Caprea

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely. The book gives no age: 50 is assumed from the magus's rank.

characters.summary:
Maga of House Bjornaer, at present a guest of Crintera; her rank and age are not recorded.

She is using the covenant's library to finish a bestiary she means to present at the Tribunal of 1221. By accident she blinded the familiar of Carolus of Oculus Septentrionalis, who had come as a peace envoy, and so deepened the feud between the covenants.

characters.name: Dietrich
characters.summary:
Leader of the Bear Clan, the biggest men of Crintera's turb, who fight with maces and bare hands.

A huge man in a bearskin cape that carries the power of transformation; legend wrongly says it is the Founder's own skin. He has an uncanny knack for spotting shapechangers, which works in part even on Bjornaer magi.

characters.name: Janis
characters.summary:
Volkhv of the Forest Brothers and leader of the Swan Clan, Crintera's crafters and companions with powers other than shapeshifting.

He is the covenant's go-between with Rügen's pagans and is consulted on the island and its supernatural inhabitants, but may not practise his religion inside Crintera.

characters.name: Handri

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Master of House Merinita and its Primus, who shares his plans with only a few trusted advisers.

Where his predecessor Vinaria talked politics with the other Primi, he gives himself to long private embassies into faerie lands, and is rumoured to have met survivors of House Diedne. Nobody admits to seeing him cast anything but the signature spell that earned him his Mastery; a magus for some sixty years, he trained Iacob and Beechleaf of Fengheld and seems never to have sought Archmage status. His caricature is Rosmert, the imperious Queen of Irencillia's fae.

secrets.title: A faerie religion
secrets.text: He conceived the scheme for a faerie religion on becoming Primus.

secrets.title: Handri and Vinaria
secrets.text: He is secretly afraid of Vinaria and lets her do as she pleases.

characters.name: Ioannes Acer

description.biography: Equipment: bronze half scale mail, a great sword and a lance; Encumbrance 2 (3). No Twilight Scars. Also: the Flaw Magical Animal Companion, Kervus, the great faerie stag who is his caricature and steed. A faerie court, not a mundane lord, knighted him, and his Vow is to chivalry.

characters.summary:
Journeyman of House Merinita, Elder Gild trained, the youngest apprentice of the Archmaga Vinaria and only just past his Gauntlet.

An idealist steeped in romantic chivalry that will serve him poorly beyond Irencillia, he was knighted by a Faerie Court and keeps a vow of chivalry; secular lords accept the knighthood so long as they do not ask after his liege. His magic runs to Herbam and Rego, flawless but short-lived, and he fights with greatsword and lance. A robust, golden-haired, sunburnt youth in mirror-bright ornate bronze scale, never a helm, bearing a green sycamore leaf on white, he rides and jousts from his caricature Kervus, a stag huge enough to carry him. A suitable player character.

characters.name: Vinaria

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Archmaga of House Merinita and its former Prima, who stepped down after Handri outmanoeuvred her.

She is said to have entered Faerie Twilight and returned seven years later apparently unchanged. Politically formidable through long councils with the other Primi, whose contacts she uses skilfully, she is strongest in the raw elemental Arts and always dressed in beautiful glamour. Her old caricature, the faerie king, passed to Handri, and mysteriously she has acquired no new one since her return.

secrets.title: Handri's fear
secrets.text: Handri senses a new inner strength in her, fears her and avoids her entirely.

characters.name: Glesig

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Master of House Merinita and the House's foremost expert on the fae beneath the earth, a Terram specialist.

Big-boned and plain, her hair turned by Twilight into threads of shining copper. Her caricature Humnel, an immense troll, has become her faerie familiar; he is protective and hates to hear her insulted.

characters.name: Iacob filius Handri

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Master of House Merinita, leader of the Elder Gild and, after Vinaria, the covenant's most politically active magus.

A Master of Mentem unusually young, he invents spells that plant thoughts and ideas in their targets. Tall, looking barely into his thirties, he charms with an almost hypnotic voice. His caricature Nestor, a white crow, travels with him.

secrets.title: The Prophet Iacob
secrets.text: He runs Handri's secret project to found a religion in the fae's name: he is the Prophet Iacob of the God of Truth, known by his albino crow. He never shows magic to mundanes, and the Quaesitors would be deeply unhappy to learn of it.

characters.name: Gravis

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Journeyman of House Bonisagus, come to Irencillia to pursue a lifelong fascination with the fae.

Though his Faerie Lore outstrips many a Merinita's, he cannot grasp even the rudiments of Faerie Magic, which frustrates him without making him bitter; he keeps trying. Chubby and sunny, his caricature Danket is a grumpy, stick-thin, scowling dwarf.

characters.name: Richenda Spinosa

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Journeyman of House Flambeau, a Pole, and an atypical member of her House.

As an apprentice she showed a gift for fire that her master Indulius of Fengheld never knew came from a secret faerie heritage, for she descends from Kupala, a faerie lord who guards the Fire Flower in the Slavic lands. His bungling, as she sees it, scarred her Gift so that fire magic now comes very hard, and her natural Herbam talent and faerie blood made her a laughing-stock in her House. Angry, with a bent for thorn spells, she has sworn vengeance on her master and is not yet reconciled to her fae side. Her caricature Jennis is a male version of herself, from whom she learns.

characters.name: Igor Rastvan

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Archmagus of House Ex Miscellanea, of the Ash or Oak Gild like all Roznov's magi, high priest of Radegast and leader of Roznov Castle and its covenfolk.

Some eighty years past his Gauntlet and still hale, with black curly hair and a waist-length beard barely touched with grey, he always wears embroidered robes showing scenes of myth and his priestly rank. The filius of a founder and perhaps the only Archmage of his House, he draws on Slavic cursing traditions and is feared for killing from afar; many of his spells carry a non-Hermetic ritual element fed by the pagan ceremonies he leads, so that more worshippers mean more power. His ambition is dominion over all the Slavic lands united under Radegast, an obsession now so strong his filii fear Twilight has unhinged him.

characters.name: Severicus

description.biography: Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Master of House Tremere, of the Ash or Oak Gild like all Roznov's magi, and leader of Roznov Fort.

Very tall and thin, wholly bald with a neat greying beard, a noted master of Terram who detests change of every kind. He holds his own sigil, as only he and Stentorius of Fengheld do among the Rhine's Tremere, and controls about two-fifths of the others.

characters.name: Ladislaus
characters.summary:
A trusted companion of Roznov and its buyer at the Prague slave market, where he passes for a shady-looking dealer.

He has Magic Sensitivity.

secrets.title: The Gifted slaves
secrets.text: He picks out Gifted children among the slaves, who are sent to Coeris, the domus magna of House Tremere in the Transylvanian Tribunal.

secrets.title: The other slaves
secrets.text: The other slaves he buys are traded or put to work by Roznov.

secrets.title: Storyguide Notes
secrets.text: He uses his Magic Sensitivity to pick them out.

characters.name: Hilda

description.biography:
Age 28. Oversensitive to disrespect. A stout, strong custos raised at a covenant, who leads its grogs and drills them.
Mace and heater shield: Init -1, Atk +13, Def +10, Dam +12. Mace: Init -1, Atk +12, Def +6, Dam +12. Short bow: Init -3, Atk +7, Def +1, Dam +10. Pole axe: Init -1, Atk +9, Def +1, Dam +15. Dagger: Init -2, Atk +7, Def +2, Dam +7. Fist: Init -2, Atk +5, Def +2, Dam +4. Grapple: Init -2, Atk +6, Def +3, Dam n/a. Soak +9; Encumbrance 0 (4). Wounds: -1 (1-6), -3 (7-12), -5 (13-18), Incapacitated (19-24).
Equipment: full metal scale armour, mace, heater shield, pole axe, short bow, a traveller's kit of tools.

characters.summary: A custos born and bred at Fengheld and given by it to the young magi: an immense blonde woman of Size +1 with piercing blue eyes in barrel-like scale armour made to measure, fighting with mace and heater shield (Attack +13, Defence +10, Damage +12, Soak +9) and carrying a pole axe and short bow besides. Great Strength and Puissant Single Weapon; Covenant Upbringing, Obese and Oversensitive to disrespect; Single Weapon 6+2, Leadership 5, Brawl 4, Latin 3, Order of Hermes Lore 2 (Fengheld). Prime leader material, she drills raw grogs into shape, brooks no disobedience, and is unpopular with the other grogs and untroubled by it; it puzzles her that mundanes object to a woman warrior.

characters.name: Byrek

description.biography:
Age 27. A tall, unkempt runner sent away from Crintera, where his mother is a Horse Clan witch. He wears a horse-bone amulet she gave him and credits it with his speed and stamina; his Affinity with Athletics, Enduring Constitution and Long-Winded may come from it. He feels rejected and gloomy until given a real job.
Long spear: Init +5, Atk +10, Def +10, Dam +7. Axe and round shield: Init +3, Atk +8, Def +8, Dam +6. Axe: Init +3, Atk +7, Def +5, Dam +6. Fist: Init +2, Atk +4, Def +6, Dam 0. Soak +4; Encumbrance 3 (3); Fatigue OK, 0, 0, -2, -4, Unconscious.
Equipment: long spear, axe, round shield, heavy leather hauberk (taken off to run).

characters.summary: Covenfolk given away by Crintera: tall, sturdy and awkward, filthy and lice-ridden, slouching on a long spear (Attack +10, Defence +10, Damage +7). Affinity with Athletics, Enduring Constitution and Long-Winded, perhaps from his amulet; Clumsy, Depressed and Simple-Minded; Athletics 7 (running), Great Weapon 5, West Slavonic 5 (Sorbian), Survival 3, Ride 3. His mother, a witch of Crintera's Horse Clan, gave him a horse-bone amulet to make him swift and tireless as a horse, and he never takes it off, whether or not it works. A remarkable endurance runner and a reliable carrier of messages, single-minded and careless of routine; he feels Crintera cast him off, and his gloom may lift once he feels useful.

characters.name: Lord Robert Schönburg

description.biography:
Age 29. The baron of Schönburg's bastard, schooled in Cologne, where a mentor drew him into the Dark Arts. He serves the Devil for gain, bewitches people into obeying him, senses when he is about to be exposed, and works small natural magics: Intelligence + Infernal Lore + aura + stress die, cast like a Ritual (time and vis), with Shape and Material bonuses from stones and the like. A villain, not a player character.
Fist: Init -1, Atk +1, Def +1, Dam 0. Soak 0; Encumbrance 0 (0).
Equipment: fine clothes, a sword he cannot use, pouches of herbs, odd stones and animal parts; about 10 pawns of mixed vis.

characters.summary:
The bastard son of Baron Schönburg and the villain of the Gorge, not for a player. Tall and handsome with shoulder-length black hair, clean-shaven, dressed in costly black or dark green with showy jewellery bearing his device, an eagle displayed pierced through the heart by a spear, and startling green eyes that captivate women (Int +3, Pre +2). A gentleman with the Entrancement Virtue, Arcane Lore, Educated, Premonitions and a Privileged Upbringing; Avaricious, a Black Sheep, Nocturnal and Tainted with Evil; locally reputed little more than a thug. Entrancement 5 (women), Infernal Lore 4, Charm 4, Magic Lore 3, Philosophiae 3, Premonitions 3, Latin 3, Guile 3, Rhine Lore 3, Faerie Lore 1 (the Loreley); a useless fighter who carries a sword for show. He owns some 10 pawns of mixed vis and pouches of herbs, odd stones and animal parts.

Schooled in Cologne, where a mentor initiated him into the Dark Arts, he was then given the Pfalz tolls by his father and runs a gang of ruffians there in what is really piracy, gate-crashing noble gatherings to behave disgracefully.

secrets.title: Robert's master
secrets.text: A committed servant of the Devil for the gains rather than from fervour; his greed grew with his initiation.

secrets.title: Robert's bewitchment
secrets.text: People shun him, which he does not mind since his bewitchment compels obedience, used frivolously.

secrets.title: Robert's warnings
secrets.text: Premonitions warn him when exposure nears.

secrets.title: Robert's magic
secrets.text: He works minor natural magics as rituals needing time and vis, and might grow to rival a magus by dealing with a demon directly.

secrets.title: The burial mounds
secrets.text: He robbed the burial mounds on the upstream island and woke their guardians.

secrets.title: The attack on Karlotte
secrets.text: He is behind the attack on his half-sister Karlotte.

secrets.title: Storyguide Notes
secrets.text: His rituals use Intelligence, Infernal Lore, the aura and a stress die and Shape and Material bonuses from gemstones.

characters.name: Wolkan

description.biography:
Age 23. A thief branded on the cheek, let out of the Pfalz jail to collect Lord Robert's tolls, unaware they are unjust. He knows the toll trade and the dripstone sales, and has criminal contacts along the Rhine he hopes to lead.
Short sword: Init +3, Atk +10, Def +8, Dam +6. Thrown knife: Init +2, Atk +7, Def +6, Dam +3. Dagger: Init +2, Atk +7, Def +5, Dam +4. Fist: Init +2, Atk +4, Def +4, Dam +1. Soak +1; Encumbrance 0 (1).
Equipment: 2 daggers, short sword, change of clothes.

characters.summary: A branded thief and a possible grog, one of Robert's band on Pfalz Island. He would be handsome but for the livid brand on his cheek, hidden under shoulder-length brown hair; plain dress and a self-assured grace. Branded Criminal; Improved Characteristics and Social Contacts; Ambitious. Short sword (Attack +10, Defence +8, Damage +6) and thrown knife; Legerdemain 3, Stealth 3, Intrigue 3 (outlaws), Thrown Weapon 3, Rhine Lore 3 (criminals), Profession: Boatman 2. Baron Schönburg jailed him on Pfalz for theft and Robert freed him to help take tolls; he has no idea the tolls are unjust or that Robert is more than he seems. He knows the toll system, the dripstone trade against the Loreley, and the petty criminals and mercenaries of the towns up and down the Rhine.

secrets.title: Wolkan's own aim
secrets.text: His own aim is to lead his criminal contacts and get rich, perhaps with the covenant's resources.

characters.name: Karlotte Schönburg
characters.summary: Baron Schönburg's daughter and heir, a striking red-haired young woman with more than the family's usual share of faerie blood, who knows her half-brother and rival Robert for what he is. On a recent journey she was attacked by an unknown dark figure in the woods west of the castle, and her seemingly slight wounds have left her in a coma from which nothing wakes her. The fae of Dark Summer will reveal a cure for a price.

secrets.title: Who is behind the attack
secrets.text: Robert Schönburg is behind the attack on Karlotte.

secrets.title: Storyguide Notes
secrets.text: Proving it and curing her wins the baron's gratitude and with it Pfalz Island.

characters.name: Ludold
characters.summary: Elder of Waldheim, gaunt and white-haired with a necklace of bones: a cunning man and lesser hedge wizard of minor potions and charms, whose hut is shelved with bones, herbs, mushrooms and preserved organs, some perhaps vis, which he gathers round the glade. He will trade potions, charms or vis to magi who find a wife for his son Torven.

characters.name: Torven

description.biography:
Age 24. Son of Waldheim's elder and its reluctant leader, happier with animals than people. His companion Red-Hame is a faerie wolf (Faerie Might 12), the Winter Court's messenger. His Latent Magic Ability, which he cannot control, sometimes brings wolf packs to his aid.
Short bow: Init 0, Atk +9, Def +4, Dam +6. Knife: Init +1, Atk +6, Def +3, Dam +2. Fist: Init +1, Atk +5, Def +3, Dam 0. Soak +2; Encumbrance 2 (2).
Equipment: plain brown clothes, wolf-fur jerkin, bow.

characters.summary: Ludold's son, the Wise One of Waldheim and a possible companion: unassuming, with scruffy brown hair, a patchy beard and a wolf-fur jerkin (Dex +3). Animal Ken, Intuition, Latent Magical Ability and Wilderness Sense; a Magical Air; a Magical Animal Companion and Reclusive; locally reputed a Wise One. Short bow (Attack +9); Animal Ken 3 (wolves), Animal Handling 3 (pigs), Forest Lore 3 (Westerwald), Hunt 3, Stealth 3, Survival 3, Wilderness Sense 3, Faerie Lore 2 (Bright Winter), Magic Lore 2 (herbs), Teaching 2. The villagers revere him for befriending and speaking with animals and treat him as their unofficial leader, a role he hates; he is poor at talk and makes strangers wary, but animals trust him, and he would rather be deep in the forest with Red-Hame, the faerie wolf who brings the Winter Court's wishes through him. He feels responsible for the village and defends it first; his hunches have saved it from disasters natural and human, wolf packs appear to help him in dire need, and the glade's creatures, the tame wild pigs among them, obey an unspoken command of his. He learned the bow from his uncle, a Nassau forester.

characters.name: Isaac
characters.summary: Manager of the wine shop on Trier's Fleischstrasse, the old front of Treverorum, for his uncle David ben David. He knows nothing of magi, sells wine to Gentiles under the recently relaxed rabbinical rule, and was told by the shop's last owner that the bricked-up passage in the cellar is haunted.

characters.name: David ben David

description.biography:
Age 30. A rich Jewish merchant of Trier trading between Trier, Koblenz, Bingen and Mainz, schooled at the Jewish academy in Mainz; married to Sophie, no children. He will not bend his faith for an easier life, and may soon be asked to become a rabbi. His nephew Isaac runs the wine shop above Treverorum for him.
Dodge: Init 0, Def 0. Soak +1; Encumbrance 0 (0).
Equipment: plain merchant's clothes with the Jewish badge, skull cap.

characters.summary: A prominent Jewish merchant of Trier and a possible companion, owner of the wine shop over Treverorum: of average height with short black hair and long side-curls, skull-cap and prayer shawl worn openly, moderate dress with the wheel badge of Jewry (Int +2, Com +2). A wealthy merchant; Educated, Puissant Bargain, Social Contacts and Well-Travelled; Pious, an Outsider, Judged Unfairly; locally reputed simply as a Jew. Bargain 5+2, High German 6 (Yiddish), Profession: Merchant 4, Aramaic 3, Latin 3, Artes Liberales 3, Civil and Canon Law 3, Folk Ken 3, Intrigue 3, Rhine Lore 3, Jewish Theology 3, Profession: Ship's Captain 2, Medicine 2, French, Italian and Low German 2. From a still wealthier family trading between Trier, Koblenz, Bingen and Mainz, he travelled with father and uncles as a boy, entered the Jewish academy at Mainz at thirteen, and took over the business and married Sophie when his father died ten years ago; they have no children yet. He will not soften his devotion for his Christian rivals' hatred, is level-headed and thick-skinned, and is likely soon to be asked to serve as a rabbi.

characters.name: Jarvis
characters.summary: A forester of Semita Errabunda, suggested as a companion for the Gorge saga.

characters.name: Albertus Magnus
characters.summary: Albert of Cologne, born in Bavaria in 1206. If history holds he becomes the greatest natural magician and philosopher of his age: schooled at Padua, an early Dominican, a student at Bologna, a teacher at Cologne, Regensburg, Hildesheim, Freiburg and Strassburg, in Paris from 1245 and bishop of Regensburg in 1260, writing on theology, natural science, alchemy, astrology and the divination of dreams and arguing all of them compatible with Christianity. He might meet the magi, or be recruited into the Order.

secrets.title: Storyguide Notes
secrets.text: In the Divine reading of the curse his counsel is a path to grace.

characters.name: Tabanus

description.biography: Equipment: a stout blackthorn staff, the knout he carries as a walking stick and is thinking of enchanting; Encumbrance 2 (2). No Twilight Scars. Gauntleted at 23 after training at Magvillus under Jart, the leading Traditionalist of his House. The book's block gives Intellego as 10+3 with Puissant Intellego; the sheet holds the 10 and the Virtue adds the 3.

characters.summary: Journeyman of House Guernicus and a Quaesitor, filius of Jart, a peregrinator sent to the Rhine about ten years ago because the House thought its presence here weak. His evidence once Marched a Hawthorn Gild magus on what many called a technicality, and he is unpopular, that gild especially; he moves from covenant to covenant every few years, preferring young covenants that will not try to browbeat him. He lately left Triamore. With Winfrida of Durenmar he may be one of only two Guernicus in the Tribunal. The book offers him as a player character.

characters.name: Felicia

description.biography: Equipment: good quality clothes; Encumbrance 0 (0). No Twilight Scars. Her Favors are owed to Fengheld. Her magic is strongest in the winter months, when she overwinters at a covenant, and weakest in summer, when she travels to study natural wonders. The book's block gives Intrigue as 2+2 with Puissant Intrigue; the sheet holds the 2 and the Virtue adds the other 2. Story seed, A Peace Emissary: she comes to winter at the player covenant to make peace between it and an enemy covenant she visited first, and the magi may suspect a motive she does not have.

characters.summary: Journeyman of House Bonisagus, filia of Dorana of Fengheld in the lineage of Irmele, freshly Gauntleted and a peregrinator. Sturdy and weather-beaten, often taken for a young man, which lets her travel alone. Her weather magic is strongest in winter, when she overwinters at a covenant (Fengheld has promised her a spare laboratory for favours it has yet to name), and weakest in summer, when she takes to the road. The book offers her as a player character; it spells her name Felecia too.

characters.name: Lexander

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Radomir's filius, looking forty-one, and a cives (of Coeris). He believes Laniena exists to train soldiers for House Tremere, and wants the Hunters' Arts stretched to every supernatural enemy the Order might face, but has neither the skill nor the knowledge to do it, so he nags Murat the Younger to; he has more than once floated 'Hermetic magus' as a Foe Art for hunting the Marched. Murat will not let him see his pater's scripts, so every recruit must pass through Murat's hands.

He drills the Fectores without end against both steel and spells, catching monsters and setting them loose in the caves for his pupils to hunt, often at mortal risk. A master of Rego, above all with Vim, Corpus and Animal.

links.note: Sodalis and constant rival; wants Murat's scripts

characters.name: Murat the Younger

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
A Hermetic Fector, the youngest of Murat of Terezin's three apprentices, who took his master's name at his Gauntlet; he looks forty-two. A hospes (of Diodorus), whose own agreement lets him take apprentices without the Praeco's leave, so that he trains as many as he can for the Tremere war machine.

He is fascinated by the hunters of each region and often travels to chase word of a new way to fight vampires or ward off witches. He teaches his pupils the Ban Art above all, to give them a chance of living through Lexander's exercises, which only angers Lexander more. He holds his pater's initiation scripts.

characters.name: Bendis
characters.summary: The ablest of Laniena's non-Hermetic Fectores, named for the great mother goddess of the old Thracians: a warrior and a hedge wizard at once, in leather armour, with a bow and arrows made for killing vampires. She is a born leader and commands her own chosen band, trained in arms and in lore. The book prints no stats for her.

characters.name: Oeagrus

abilities.name: Mystery Cult Lore: Cult of Orpheus

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
The senior Orphic magus of the Tribunal, looking sixty-eight, who fancies himself head of the whole Cult, with no grounds at all. Unlike most of the Cult he worships Orpheus openly as a god, which has won him no friends among the Tremere. He thinks the Cult on Lesbos has Orpheus's head and is keeping it from him. He is mad: the Cult tends to call it divine madness, everyone else plain lunacy. He hates women.

Outsiders seldom see him. He goes about in a loincloth, careless of his looks, his hair wild and twigs caught in his tangled beard.

secrets.title: Oeagrus's treasure
secrets.text: His treasure is the mummified arm of Orpheus, whom the Maenads tore apart; he seeks a way to rebuild the god by grafting the dismembered body onto himself.

characters.name: Bozhidar

abilities.name: Mystery Cult Lore: Cult of Orpheus

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
The music teacher at Gela, looking thirty-eight, who usually has two or three pupils. His Study Bonus has made him strong in Imaginem from what his students bring, and he now needs ever finer musicians to learn from.

A good-looking man with dark curls and an easy smile, thickening round the middle since the village's unmarried women began bringing him honey cakes.

characters.name: Yekaterina

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Evredika's aedile, the latest of a line, looking thirty-two. Oeagrus usually sours each 'Tremere overseer', as he calls them, enough that they ask to leave after a decade or so, and he takes a woman in the post as a double insult from the House. She means, for now, to stay, and from her lonely sanctum in the Devil's Throat has deepened her study of necromancy.

Slender and fair, she wears a mask made of a skull, which she has begun to turn into her talisman.

characters.name: Benilda

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Chief Quaesitor of the Tribunal and leader of Seuthopolis, a head of the Transitionalists in House Guernicus. She thinks the Tremere may be right that the way magi live is going to change, which will test those who keep justice hard, and innovates in law to ready her House. She specialises in investigation and keeps the Red and Black Libraries.

The Traditionalists call her brand of Transitionalism collusion with House Tremere to bend the Code, but can do little against her while Tremere backs her: without Tremere arms the Quaesitors would struggle to make Autumn covenants elsewhere obey the Code. She thought it feeble of the Prima of Guernicus to give up reconciling the factions and send them to fight case by case at Tribunal; but since that is the war now, with the Order's future at stake, she will play politics as ruthlessly as any Traditionalist.

She presides at Tribunal, witnesses oaths and binds contracts into the Peripheral Code; accusations are laid before her, and she is the Quaesitor characters meet for the Tribunal's business.

characters.name: Caledonia

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
The older Quaesitor sent where things are dangerous, raised (as her name says) in the Loch Leglean Tribunal. She has an odd faerie blood, that of the Washerwoman of the Ford, which shows her visions of her own possible death and her foes'. Her investigative spells are weak, but in Wizard's War she is skilful and unpredictable, and her speciality is magical self-defence.

Met on her investigations, she can ask any magus for all reasonable help: lodging and supplies, and often companions and grogs with local knowledge or useful skills. She attends every Wizard's March. She seeks friends among the Merinita, thought partial in Scotland but of no matter here.

characters.name: Saturnino

abilities.name: Mystery Cult Lore: Path of Strife

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely. The book gives no age: 80 is assumed from the magus's rank.

personality_traits.name: Determined to do evil by doing what others call good

characters.summary:
Marshal of Transylvania: House Guernicus's chief hoplite in the Tribunal, the senior lictor and leader of Wizard's Marches; his age is unknown. He is one of the elders of the Path of Strife, Criamon extremists who do evil so that their Housemates may stay clean, and who, unlike other Criamon, plunge into the world to dirty themselves. His House's notion of evil is so strange that he usually seems a very ordinary magus: eating meat is evil, and so is having a wife, and he does both.

Only slowly do others see that he finds no moral difference between a bacon pie and burning a child, and would do either if it were needed. He knows right from wrong and, without remorse, picks wrong when it must be done, so others need not; but he does no pointless cruelty, will not deal with demons, which he thinks personal weakness, and will not betray his sect or his wife, since that would be right. He kills magi well and, in his own odd terms, can be relied on. He is still a Criamon, with riddles, strange quests and errands to magical places, only more often bloody to the elbows. He excels at surprising foes and at mystical swordplay.

secrets.title: Why Saturnino serves
secrets.text: He serves here because he thinks gathering the Red and Black Libraries was a deep error, and because he wonders whether the Tribunal's strange faeries come of the Criamon having stolen the World Tree.

characters.name: Scipio

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
The mediator, skilled in talk and Mentem magic. At Tribunal each side argues and the rest vote, so Tremere's opponents always lose and Tremere wins only by making enemies; with Scipio between them a magus can settle with another magus or an oppidum without forcing the House to take sides. He would like a posting to a Tribunal where, without someone like him, blood might be shed; his superiors agree he will be useful there one day, but want him to keep honing his skills first, since there the smallest slip could be costly.

The easiest of the four Quaesitors to approach: gentle in manner, less strict about the letter of the law, and willing to give legal advice. He can sometimes calm a quarrel between the characters and someone they have angered, though they may have to give ground.

characters.name: Terencia

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
A lictor on Caledonia's team and the oppidum's aedile, a young maga trained as a military scout, whose magic carries her fast through a country and weighs its dangers. She was put with Caledonia because the Quaesitor lacks many investigative spells; she is no great fighter, but Caledonia is far deadlier than most Quaesitors and her fellow lictor Saturnino is among the Order's most feared. She hopes a turn with the Quaesitors will help her to a posting abroad later.

A Rego Corpus specialist with, like many of her House, some Terram, she wants her talisman to be a trophy of a famous case she helps Caledonia crack. Knowing she needs friends among young magi, and wanting some her own age, she is easy to approach and can help characters against their foes; she loves the work but never seems to have time to herself.

characters.name: Vigilia

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
A bitter old maga whom nothing magi do to each other surprises any more. Her spells find out what magi have done without breaking the Code, and she specialises in spying on magi. She always goes with two hoplites strong enough to cut her free of a camp that is in on a plot: dark Merinita once ambushed her and took both her legs, and though she regrew them with Corpus vis, seeing two suspects eat her feet made her careful.

She is the only working Quaesitor of the Tribunal censured for breaking the Code, for spying on a magus by accident while casting without force; she kept her place because her accuser asked for mercy, but may no longer investigate the Histrian oppida, where she cannot seem neutral. Characters are right to distrust her, and she is becoming a problem for her House, but she is good at reading and undoing magical defences. She is called to judge whether a magus died in his laboratory, and to assess ancient magical sites.

characters.name: Nestor

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Curator of Tablinum since 1170, looking forty-eight: tall and bone-thin, in a monk's habit dyed bright yellow, walking with a quick, jerky, insect-like stride. His sigil is a tic of teleportation, made far worse by his Twilights: he vanishes and reappears an instant later half a step away.

He affects to live apart from Tribunal politics, as for years he truly did, but for a decade he has feared that other Tremere are plotting against him, though he has found no plot. He knows that finding none may mean he is going mad, and since there might be a plot he dares tell no one of either fear. He may be both mad and the target of a plot.

He studies what he believes is the drift of regiones against one another: Leap of Homecoming, he says, takes a tiny, measurable time that depends on the levels left and reached and changes from trip to trip, and a great brass orrery in his laboratory, whose spheres are regiones, plots their motion. He has found no use for it, may be quite wrong, and will not raise the subject, but will eagerly compare notes with a magus who does.

characters.name: Demetrius

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Tablinum's aedile, trained in the Theban Tribunal, young, keen to learn and fluent in Latin, Greek and Arabic. Born Basem in the Saracen lands, he was cast out by his village for his Blatant Gift and was living like a beast in the waste when a Bonisagus Seeker passing by found him. He now understands his Gift and bears his family no grudge, but abandonment left him desperate to please new friends: he knows it and tries not to act like an anxious puppy, though he usually sees how foolish he looked only after some pleading offer is made.

His sigil is a faint pop, as if something small left the world, louder as his spells grow stronger. He spends long hours fixing the catalogues, shamefully wrong in his view, and means to send copies to the other Tribunals, since sharing knowledge was Bonisagus's vision; he suspects the others here do not agree.

characters.name: Theodora

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Theodore's twin, looking twenty-eight. Nestor took in the twins as bawling infants and hid them with two nurses in a secret regio until their Gifts could be Opened and he could claim them as apprentices. Theodora is noisy, her hair long and matted and her habits filthy, and screams, spits and throws things when crossed, yet she forgets slights quickly and bears with the beast in everyone. She took her longevity potion in her early twenties out of vanity and soon rued the barrenness it brought.

Her magic, like her laboratory, is showy and reckless: she keeps tipping new ingredients, seemingly at random, into an ever-boiling cauldron, which she swears improves her magic, and her laboratory does often turn out work beyond her.

characters.name: Theodore

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Theodora's twin, though looking sixty he could pass for her father. He hardly speaks except to the two nurses who raised them, now old women in their seventies, one almost blind and one bedridden, who still live in the nursery regio. He never raises his voice and keeps himself, his clothes and his laboratory spotless, with grogs guarding its door in shifts; he spends hours gazing at the still pool at its heart.

His ideas are strange. He thinks body hair breeds disease and keeps himself hairless by magic, and he put off his longevity potion until fifty, perhaps only to mock his sister.

characters.name: Accursius Adiran

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
The chief Mercere: an aged magus who leads the Histrian magi and the Tribunal's Redcaps after a fashion. He has great standing and decides which Redcaps get longevity rituals, but cannot really make the sprawling family obey; long since reconciled to that, he steers it through yearly meetings of the heads of the main families. He works at craftwork and illusion.

Too old to travel without magic, he keeps to his laboratory, at Shrouded Bay because it is nicer, though his lab there is worse than the one he leaves to Volante. He can send Redcap families to help, make weak longevity rituals fit for young magi, open the House's cache of items, and he collects favours to spend when a Redcap's trouble goes beyond what the Code obliges magi to fix.

Every few years the lab-bound life gets too much and he takes a holiday, famous for embarrassment, scrapes and scandal; when he vanishes, word goes round the Redcaps to watch for the Old Man and keep things quiet. He may turn up on one of these jaunts in a town near the players' oppidum.

characters.name: Leontine Adiran

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
The Tribunal's chief negotiator: only thirty, yet one of the finest communicators in Mythic Europe, encouraged to grow her gift for diplomacy at the cost of her magic, a bargain she accepts gladly for now. She works in espionage, and usually travels with Merit of Tremere. Her task is to threaten, bribe and persuade, so she seeks out magi with narrow Affinities for help, and pays in introductions to the most powerful magi in this and the neighbouring Tribunals, or in the name of exactly the right person.

She is not Dominic of Tytalus's apprentice but his protégée; rumour, knowing the Tytalus, invents a passionate affair seasoned with murder attempts. In truth he enjoys a sharp, amusing pupil and she a wily mentor and something of a father. She also sharpens her wits arguing ethics with an ancient zmaj of Istria.

characters.name: Pahniro Adiran

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

personality_traits.name: Likes fooling people with his old codger act

characters.summary:
The aedile of Old Histria, an old Tremere near Twilight given the post as a useful retirement, since few in the House expect trouble at Histria; he is the House's eyes on this western gate. He equips mundane spies, is rumoured to run the House's agents in the Roman Tribunal, and laughs that off: surely a spymaster would live in Venice? He says he is only an old man finishing his talisman as a legacy, with Placido as his lab assistant.

Anyone breaking the Code nearby may meet him first, sizing things up before he calls the hoplites and Quaesitors. A prolific letter writer, he asks Tremere for help when he wants to look into something without alarming the Redcaps, and trades news with others for favours; coloniae often owe senior Tremere aid by their terms, so players may be bound to serve his whims. The Mercere often send him after strigons, which he passes to younger magi.

secrets.title: Pahniro's frailty
secrets.text: His doddering is misdirection: he served twenty years as a hoplite and has killed three magi in single combat.

characters.name: Placido Adiran

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
The aedile of Shrouded Bay, a young Tremere with an Affinity for Aquam who runs the House's trading fleet, keeps it ready for war, and specialises in battle magic at sea. Lately taken with naval sabotage, he has money to try new ways of fighting ships and wants partners; keeping even a small navy supplied means endless dealing with suppliers, their rivals and the local nobles, so he calls on coloniae with strategic land or odd faerie resources and on anyone with useful skills when new ports open.

He loathes pirates with startling zeal. At heart he loves fights to the death for the thrill, but will not see himself as a murderer, so he turns the urge on people everyone agrees deserve it, and invites players with a gift for mayhem or swift travel to clear pirate nests with him. He is also Pahniro's lab assistant on his talisman, a service other Houses think beneath a magus but the Tremere do not.

characters.name: Priscilla of Verditius

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

personality_traits.name: Wants to do her own thing

characters.summary:
A maga of middle years who spends most of her time at Old Histria brewing longevity potions for the unGifted, a waste of her talent, she thinks. She has quarrelled with her teacher, yet has neither the wish to join a frontier oppidum nor the political skill to win better terms; she will not call herself Adiran, feeling she does not belong, and longs for a workshop to make magical puppets in peace.

She hates discussing her rote work, but is a treasure for anyone founding a colonia: she knows the local law and custom, the sites of local legend, and the promising places the Tribunal's survey has marked for settlement, and though her ties to senior magi are weak, she knows whom to ask.

characters.name: Volante Adiran

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
A Gifted Mercere from Italy, likely to follow Accursius when he dies or fades into Twilight, though she has even less hold on the local family than he does. Her recent marriage to a man of an old Redcap line made her less of a stranger, but pulls her from her work of putting right what goes wrong for the family; the couple live in Accursius's fine suite and laboratory at Old Histria. She is skilled in travel and flying magic, though politics has cut into her studies.

When a Redcap is hurt or killed, she is the one who comes, and the one to report to. She effectively commands the small fighting part of the Redcap fleet and lends items that help Redcaps force a way through hard country. The senior Redcaps want her to raise an heir or two so the family gets leaders who know local ways rather than a new magus from Harco each generation; she will not take apprentices yet, which may cause friction when she succeeds. She seeks favours for her House, and a magical bird as her familiar.

characters.name: Merit

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely. The book gives no age: 70 is assumed from the magus's rank.

characters.summary:
An older Tremere, shaven-headed and heavily muscled, with a stare that could split masonry, who lives at the Histrian chapter house in Venice and usually goes with Leontine on her missions as the Tremere half of the Tribunal's envoys.

A member of Old Histria lodged in Venice, in the Roman Tribunal; the book gives no age or privilege.

characters.name: Albertus

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Archmagus and Praeco of Transylvania, chosen by vote with the Prima's blessing, and the magus who runs Lycaneon's work: he hands out projects, keeps them to time, commissions pieces from skilled item-makers, and is the one to see about buying or borrowing an item. An engineer by training and a Rego specialist who also favours Terram and Vim, he follows who is in the Tribunal and what they do, because building teams is his great talent.

One of the Order's youngest archmagi, he is a magnet for challengers, and his known Rego bent makes him weak at certamen. Expecting to lose challenges fast, he set his challenge as the most useful item given to House Tremere after three years' work: it puts off Verditius magi loath to part with their best, it cannot be finished in one Tribunal, the House gains a fine item even if he loses, and only a few Tremere know the whole reserve, so a rival's powerful piece may duplicate something the House already owns. He has faced one challenge and won.

He has no plan yet to seek the Prima's seat, though he expects to want it one day. As Primus he would build a network of hidden roads, coaching houses and hospitals across the Tribunal, commission spells across the Order, send Redcaps to scout and magi to clear routes, invite the best item-crafters to work, perhaps sponsor a prize at the Verdi contest, and keep the House's engineers busy for years.

characters.name: Arhmina

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
A young Moorish sorceress from Iberia, a colona, who favours Rego and Vim. She came to Lycaneon to help House Tremere devise counterspells to her own tradition, for reasons she keeps to herself; gossip says a rival who wanted to marry her beat her in a run of magical duels, and she wants shelter first and revenge later. Her pay is a fine longevity ritual, good study books and items made to hurt that rival, and if she proves useful, Tremere help when she goes home to face him.

She means to stay no more than ten years, and to use them: raising her Arts, learning the strange spirits of the dark mountains, visiting Constantinople, maybe going on to Mecca. She works closely with Clement, and travellers may meet her on the road.

characters.name: Clement

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
A middle-aged Tremere, trained first as a magical spy, who specialises in Mentem spells for battle and is a necromancer; he favours Rego, Perdo, Mentem and Vim. He was called back to Lycaneon for the Prima's plan to carry the House's power into the Levant, and is researching how to sway the minds of the spirits Arab sorcerers draw on.

He wants to meet Muslim magicians to find more simple wards against such spirits, works closely with Arhmina, and spends time in the Muslim towns the King of Hungary founded for his officials, where folk magicians driven out of the Levant will happily work for Christians. His spells so far use two ideas: the spirits shun the name of God as Muslims say it, which strong Creo Imaginem can carry far, and many djinn are said to be of smokeless fire, so bitter cold outside their Magic Resistance may hurt them. He is no hand at that second kind of magic and would welcome a partner who is.

characters.name: Phillip

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
A young Herbam specialist known for spells that build and keep siege engines, who favours Muto, Rego, Herbam and Terram. He is testing, with scale models in big tanks in his huge laboratory, which magically made woods best suit magical shipbuilding: not a new question, but he is painfully thorough. Samples of rare wood are precious to him, since studying one makes the species easier to copy by magic. His findings will go to the group of Tremere working to make ships a reliable platform for magi in battle.

He holds an arcane connection to Leviathan, the House's mothballed Adriatic naval base, and would move there if a sea war came; with his skill and its yards, the House would lack crews, not hulls. He is often at Shrouded Bay working on the Tremere and Mercere fleets. He dreams of a naval base in the Hungarian mountains, reached through the passages he believes join the Tribunal's lakes to the sea, and would lead an expedition into one if he could.

characters.name: Zalmoxis

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Archmagus, a hospes, the senior Verditius in the Tribunal, who has worked at Lycaneon for more than forty years. He specialises in Corpus, above all healing on the battlefield and curing disease, and in longevity potions and rituals. He bears a local pagan god's name but has nothing to do with the old cult.

The Tremere need him: their focus on certamen leaves none of them with a magical focus fit for longevity work, so they buy the lesser rituals from young Verditius and the best from Corpus experts in other Tribunals for their senior magi. The House always keeps at least one such expert close, so that in an Order-wide crisis it can still train healers and extenders of life.

characters.name: Simium Arileins

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
The school's eldest magus and its headmaster, known across the Order as a historian and philosopher and a tireless author of beginners' texts on many subjects, the Arts among them, found as far off as Stonehenge and Iberia, though mostly fit only for young magi. He looks fifty-eight.

Years at the lectern have bent his back, and his small dark eyes blink constantly; he dresses in plain black robes and a black skullcap. His heartbeast is a raven bigger than a man, through the Mystery of the Inner Heartbeast, and his flights over the mountains have bred local tales of a demon bird that can carry off a grown man.

characters.name: Andrew Melanchthon

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
A Tremere who left the Rhine Tribunal after loud public quarrels with a leading Bonisagus branded him an empiricist and an atheist and ended any hope of office there. The charge of atheism is unjust: like most Tremere he is impious, not godless; his real offence was saying aloud that God is no loving father. He looks thirty-six.

The Scholomance lets him teach his own course: moral philosophy and rhetoric from texts the establishment calls heretical or blasphemous. He dreams of pupils carrying his humanist programme into Europe's universities and courts.

characters.name: Sebastian
characters.summary:
The tower's caretaker and a tutor, a riddle: he was its only inhabitant when Jeremiah of Tremere first got in, in 1095, and has not visibly aged since. He looks an ordinary man in his forties. Most magi think him some kind of magic kin, but those rude enough to probe him with magic found nothing, not even a Might score, and the headmaster works to keep the resulting suspicion in check. He tells each headmaster his secret, or part of it, helps run the school, knows the tower and its regio better than anyone, and has helped headmasters master it in hard times.

Friendly but close, he enjoys knowing more than others, except when he teaches philosophy, the liberal arts, dead languages and forgotten lore, which he loves.

Some magi have noticed that his name is close to that of the dragon king Aževastjepan; nobody has confronted him, but they tread warily round him.

secrets.title: Sebastian's true nature
secrets.text: Sebastian may be Aževastjepan himself, the seven-headed dragon king of the Carpathians, in human guise.

characters.name: Ludmilla
characters.summary:
A Romanian strigoica, a witch: a Gifted folk witch (see the hedge traditions) with the Entrancement Ability, in her middle fifties, slim, her beauty fading; she hides her hands, which are knotted and swollen at the knuckles. She teaches pupils the Supernatural Abilities she shares with them, for free use of the oppidum's books.

She also uses the school to spot recruits for the coven she leads. The masters politely look away, because she has sometimes Initiated an unGifted Tremere agent trained there into one of her tradition's Abilities. People suspect her of being a nightwalker, which she denies.

secrets.title: What Ludmilla denies
secrets.text: She is a nightwalker. When she walks, her phantasticum is a white moth with a lovely young girl's face.

characters.name: Poena

description.biography: Against the Dark: The Transylvanian Tribunal prints no stat block for this magus. These stats are not an official write-up: they are inferred from the book's description by the creation rules. The storyguide may change them freely.

characters.summary:
Prima of House Tremere these two years, and arguably the most powerful magus in Mythic Europe in politics: slight and stern, silver-haired, with a perfect memory. She holds every entry of the Book of Legacies in her head, knows every Tremere by name and roughly what each is doing, and fits her exarchs' and spies' reports together into elaborate designs. She favours Intellego, Muto, Imaginem and Mentem.

She governs the whole House, but quietly, through her secretaries, councillors, exarchs and legata. She always wants new pieces for her plans, unlike those she has, so magi from outside the House who act predictably are valuable to her; she holds the key to the richest stores in Europe and likely knows what the player characters want, or where to find it.

characters.name: Angiola
